trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"gnutls/fuzz/gnutls_pkcs12_key_parser_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":26,"var":"raw","code":"gnutls_datum_t raw = {(unsigned char*)data, (unsigned int)size};","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes from the fuzzer input are wrapped as the PKCS#12 blob to parse."},
{"step":2,"file":"gnutls/fuzz/gnutls_pkcs12_key_parser_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":35,"var":"p12","code":"gnutls_pkcs12_import(p12, &raw, GNUTLS_X509_FMT_DER, 0);","note":"The raw input is decoded into an in-memory PKCS#12 structure that later drives bag iteration."},
{"step":3,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse","line":1546,"var":"key_id_size","code":"size_t key_id_size = 0;","note":"The parser starts with a zero-length key identifier buffer length, so any later comparison depends on whether this value is updated."},
{"step":4,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse","line":1585,"var":"bag","code":"ret = gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag(p12, idx, bag);","note":"Each PKCS#12 bag is fetched from the attacker-controlled structure and inspected for keys and certificates."},
{"step":5,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse","line":1612,"var":"key","code":"ret = gnutls_x509_privkey_import_pkcs8(*key, &data, GNUTLS_X509_FMT_DER, password, ...);","note":"A private key bag is imported successfully, and the code then computes its key identifier."},
{"step":6,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse","line":1620,"var":"key_id_size","code":"ret = gnutls_x509_privkey_get_key_id(*key, 0, key_id, &key_id_size);","note":"The private-key identifier buffer length is set to the actual digest size, establishing the comparison length used later."},
{"step":7,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse","line":1670,"var":"cert_id_size","code":"cert_id_size = sizeof(cert_id);","note":"When a certificate bag is encountered, the certificate identifier length is initialized to the full 20-byte buffer size."},
{"step":8,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse","line":1672,"var":"cert_id","code":"ret = gnutls_x509_crt_get_key_id(this_cert, 0, cert_id, &cert_id_size);","note":"The certificate key identifier is written into cert_id and cert_id_size is reduced to the returned digest length."},
{"step":9,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse","line":1680,"var":"memcmp(cert_id, key_id, cert_id_size)","code":"if (memcmp(cert_id, key_id, cert_id_size) != 0) {","note":"The code compares cert_id against key_id using cert_id_size, assuming both buffers contain initialized bytes for that many positions."},
{"step":10,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse","line":1680,"var":"key_id","code":"memcmp(cert_id, key_id, cert_id_size)","note":"If the certificate identifier is longer than the private-key identifier, memcmp reads past the initialized portion of key_id, triggering the MSAN use-of-uninitialized-value sink."}
]
path=pathlib.Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
path.write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(path.read_text())
PY
